page.notes: The woodcut initial is a T, read from "THES." (Thes. = thesis). The Greek phrase in the first line is not legible at this scan resolution, so it is marked illegible. Right-margin notes "Arist. 5." and "Physic. text. 3." are read with some doubt on their numerals. The "Fol. 1" folio is printed in italic, read as 1 with some doubt. The catchword is printed as "for=" (hyphen) and is copied as "for-".
